cause.behavior: The kernel rejects the complete step when any single river-boundary face has interior depth below 1e-8 m.
cause.finding: The tributary sections remain broadly wet; only shallow bank-edge faces approach the dry threshold.
cause.conclusion: The stop is a per-face wet/dry guard mismatch, not evidence that the Nishikawa or Magarigawa boundary section is fully dry.

recommendedMinimalChange.behavior: Treat an individually dry river-boundary face as a wall for that step and redistribute the prescribed discharge over the remaining wet faces.
recommendedMinimalChange.failClosedCondition: Stop only when a nonzero-discharge boundary section has no wet faces or no positive wetted depth-length.
recommendedMinimalChange.existingPrototypeEvidence: tools/stage20_depth_weighted_boundary_kernel_candidate_v3.py already implements this dry-face-to-wall rule, but it is currently untracked and was not part of the failed package.
recommendedMinimalChange.nextValidation: Use a targeted boundary unit regression and a short continuation comparison before any full 6-condition rerun.
